findings.root_cause: terrainBlend.ts:44–56,65–71,91–100. Vertex discs with radius .64 R overlap; the first eligible vertex is chosen in cell-local order. The ripple is evaluated only in the 2+1 branch, leaving ordinary and three-color edges without the specified subtle fringe.
